name: my-team/my-first-model
intendedUse: Reference local-navigation policy for MARS-X, trained on scenario jezero-v1/l1/rtg-geometry on the Jezero 2 m planning grid: a baseline to compare user models against, and a demo of real learning.
limitations: Trained on random start/goal pairs 40-700 m apart in the north part of the grid (rows < 768); test metrics are on the unseen south part with the same distance band. Sees only an 11x11 local window (22 m): dead ends larger than that cause failures; long routes need global waypoints (A*). Other agents/conditions than the training scenario are out of distribution. Not a flight-ready controller. Official jezero-v1 suite (verified by re-simulation): L1 0.530, L2 0.539 success (90 L2 violations).
